raw_response.context:
Hoagies & Hops is an Indianapolis sandwich shop owned and operated by Kristina Mazza, who opened the business after moving from southeastern Pennsylvania to Indiana in 2007 (the website's earliest page date is 2017, suggesting that is approximately when the business launched). Kristina holds a degree in Restaurant and Hospitality Management from Penn State University (2002) and previously worked as General Manager at Elbow Room and Operations Manager for LUX Restaurants in Indianapolis. The concept was inspired by missing the authentic PA delis and hoagie shops she grew up with, and nearly all ingredients are sourced from South Jersey, Philadelphia, and the PA Dutch region — including rolls shipped in from South Jersey (Liscio's rolls for cheesesteaks, rolls from South Jersey for hoagies).

The restaurant does offer **catering** (a dedicated catering page exists on the website). The **Fletcher Place location is 21+**. No specific address, cross streets, parking details, or hours are explicitly stated in the provided content, though a "Visit Us" contact page exists on the site.

For **dietary accommodations**, the menu explicitly offers a **vegetarian cheesesteak option (chopped jackfruit)**, a **vegan Italian sausage**, and a **lo-carb/gluten-friendly option** of having any hoagie or cheesesteak served on a bed of lettuce or on a whole sliced deli pickle. A vegetarian cheese hoagie and vegetable fries basket are also available.

**Notable menu specialties** include authentic Pennsylvania hoagies (small, regular, and large) named after PA landmarks and personalities (e.g., Brotherly Love, Hog Island, Zern's, Dutch Country), shaved ribeye cheesesteaks on Liscio's South Jersey rolls, Nathan's All Beef Hot Dogs with creative PA-inspired preparations (Texas Tommy, Dutch Dog, Phreedom Dog), PA Dutch sides (Ring Bologna, Lebanon Bologna, pickled red beet eggs, soft pretzels shipped from Westchester PA, Nan's Red Skin Potato Salad using a grandmother's recipe), and Hank's craft sodas from Philadelphia. Liscio's rolls and select Dietz & Watson and PA Dutch meats are also available for retail purchase, along with PA Dutch Scrapple and Taylor Pork Roll (call to check availability).

A **9% sales tax** is added to all orders. Extra charges apply for sauces, cheeses, peppers, veggies, and meats not included in a menu item's description. A kids' menu ($7, ages 12 and under) includes fries and a fountain drink. Virtual gift cards are available. No delivery radius, minimum order, or cash-only policy is explicitly stated in the provided content.
